stemEn: A 5-year-old has recurrent leg pain almost every night for several weeks. Massage relieves the pain. There is no fever, weight loss, examination abnormality, or basic laboratory abnormality. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يصف growing pains: ألم متكرر غالبًا في الطرفين السفليين، يحدث مساءً أو ليلًا، والفحص والوظيفة النهارية طبيعيان ولا توجد red flags مثل fever أو weight loss.
reasoningEn: Nocturnal self-limited limb pain with a normal examination and no systemic features matches the source description of growing pains.
clinicalPearl: Night pain with normal daytime function and no red flags favors growing pains rather than inflammatory or malignant disease.
managementSteps: Simple comfort measures such as massage as appropriate

tts.text: A five-year-old has recurrent leg pain almost every night for several weeks. Massage relieves the pain. There is no fever, weight loss, examination abnormality, or basic laboratory abnormality. What is the most likely diagnosis? A. Growing pains.

stemEn: A 12-year-old girl with joint stiffness, oral ulcers and rash has leukopenia, anemia, positive ANA and positive anti-dsDNA. Which additional laboratory finding is expected?
explanationAr: في SLE عند الأطفال، leukopenia شائعة ويمكن أن تظهر lymphopenia. الخيارات الأخرى لا تتماشى مع نمط المصدر: قد يحدث thrombocytopenia وليس thrombocytosis، وقد يكون Direct Coombs إيجابيًا، كما قد تنخفض complement levels مع النشاط.
reasoningEn: The source identifies lymphopenia as a common hematologic feature in childhood SLE.

incorrectOptionsAr.B: SLE قد يسبب thrombocytopenia بدل thrombocytosis.
incorrectOptionsAr.C: قد يكون Direct Coombs إيجابيًا حتى دون hemolysis واضح.
incorrectOptionsAr.D: ارتفاع C3/C4 ليس النمط الذي يدعم active SLE في شرح المصدر.

clinicalPearl: Cytopenias are common hematologic manifestations of pediatric SLE.

stemEn: A patient has a typical presentation of systemic lupus erythematosus. Which listed antibody is the most specific for the diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار anti-Sm كأكثر antibody specificity ضمن الخيارات لـSLE. ويذكر أن ANA حساس لكنه أقل specificity، وأن anti-dsDNA وanti-Sm كلاهما شديدا specificity مع اختلاف الحساسية.
reasoningEn: Among the listed choices, the source keys anti-Smith antibody as the most specific SLE marker.

incorrectOptionsAr.A: anti-dsDNA شديد النوعية أيضًا لكنه ليس مفتاح المصدر هنا.

clinicalPearl: Anti-Sm is highly specific for SLE, although sensitivity is limited.
diagnosticSteps: ANA as a sensitive screening marker
Disease-specific autoantibodies according to clinical context

stemEn: A neonate has bradycardia on ECG in a scenario suggestive of neonatal lupus. Which laboratory finding is most likely?
explanationAr: الـneonatal lupus وخصوصًا congenital heart block يرتبط في المصدر بوجود maternal/infant anti-Ro/SSA وanti-La/SSB antibodies. قد توجد hematologic manifestations، لكن thrombocytopenia ليست العلامة المفتاحية للسؤال.
reasoningEn: The source links neonatal lupus with maternal/infant anti-Ro/SSA and anti-La/SSB antibodies, particularly in congenital heart block.

incorrectOptionsAr.B: قد تحدث cytopenias في neonatal lupus لكنها ليست association الرئيسية المطلوبة هنا.

clinicalPearl: Neonatal lupus with heart block should prompt recognition of anti-Ro/SSA and anti-La/SSB antibodies.

stemEn: A child has heliotrope discoloration around the eyes, Gottron papules and symmetric proximal muscle weakness. Which laboratory marker is expected to be elevated?
explanationAr: الصورة السريرية هي juvenile dermatomyositis. شرح المصدر يذكر أن muscle enzymes مثل CK/CPK وLDH وaldolase وAST/ALT قد ترتفع وتدعم وجود myositis.
reasoningEn: Classic JDM skin findings plus proximal weakness are supported by elevated muscle enzymes, including CK.
clinicalPearl: Heliotrope rash + Gottron papules + proximal weakness is a classic JDM pattern.
diagnosticSteps: Further myositis testing as clinically indicated

stemEn: A child with proximal muscle weakness has the pictured heliotrope rash. Which additional cutaneous sign may be seen?
explanationAr: المصدر يربط juvenile dermatomyositis بالـheliotrope rash وphotosensitive erythema على الصدر/الكتفين والظهر، وعندما تكون على هذه المنطقة تسمى shawl sign.
reasoningEn: The source describes the shawl sign as a characteristic photosensitive erythema in juvenile dermatomyositis.
clinicalPearl: Shawl-sign erythema is a classic cutaneous clue to dermatomyositis.

stemEn: Which pattern of muscle weakness is described in the source for dermatomyositis?

options.label: A
options.text: Distal weakness with an ascending pattern

options.label: B
options.text: Distal weakness with a descending pattern

options.label: C
options.text: Proximal weakness with an ascending pattern

options.label: D
options.text: Proximal weakness with a descending pattern

recalledAnswer.label: D
recalledAnswer.text: Proximal weakness with a descending pattern

explanationAr: المصدر يختار D ويشرح أن weakness في dermatomyositis تكون mainly proximal ثم قد تتأثر العضلات distal مع تقدم المرض. مصطلح ascending/descending هنا غير قياسي بما يكفي، لذلك أبقيت مفتاح المصدر مع علامة مراجعة بدل اعتباره verified.
reasoningEn: The source keys option D, while its explanation more securely supports proximal-predominant weakness with possible later distal involvement; the directional label requires review.

incorrectOptionsAr.A: لا يتفق مع proximal predominance في شرح المصدر.
incorrectOptionsAr.C: الجزء proximal يتفق، لكن المصدر لم يختر هذا الوصف الاتجاهي.

clinicalPearl: The robust clinical concept is symmetric proximal muscle weakness; directional wording should not be overinterpreted.

stemEn: A 12-year-old boy has inflammatory sacroiliac pain and morning stiffness relieved by activity, uveitis, patellar enthesitis, HLA-B27 positivity, and negative RF and ANA. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: النمط يجمع enthesitis + inflammatory sacroiliac/back pain + HLA-B27 + anterior uveitis، وهو ما يطابق Enthesitis-related arthritis حسب شرح المصدر.
reasoningEn: Inflammatory axial symptoms, enthesitis, HLA-B27 positivity and uveitis strongly fit ERA in the source.

incorrectOptionsAr.B: systemic JIA يرتبط أكثر بالحمى اليومية والـsalmon rash والـsystemic features.
incorrectOptionsAr.C: oligoarticular JIA لا يفسر هذا النمط المحوري وHLA-B27 بنفس القوة.
incorrectOptionsAr.D: polyarticular JIA لا يطابق enthesitis/sacroiliitis phenotype هنا.

clinicalPearl: Think ERA when a school-age boy has enthesitis or inflammatory sacroiliac pain with HLA-B27-associated features.
diagnosticSteps: Ophthalmologic assessment for uveitis as indicated
